faq: No. We use supplier facts such as sizes and materials, but we write original text so your pages are not word-for-word copies of other stores. That is better for shoppers and for search.
How do you know details about my products?
From the facts you send: spec sheets, supplier data, packaging text and photos. If something is unclear, we ask rather than guess. We do not write health or results claims that you cannot support.
Can you write in my brand voice?
Yes. Send two or three examples you like, or describe your tone in a few lines. We write a sample for approval before doing the rest, so the voice is settled early.
Will you add the text to my store?
Yes. We paste the descriptions into your products with clean formatting and check them on a phone. If you prefer, we hand you a spreadsheet so you can import them yourself.
